item.title: All Eyes, No Fingertips: Why General Robots Still Lack a Sense of Touch
item.description: Picking up from Sim-to-Real methodology and robot data scaling: those two pieces talked about how to budget and intervene on the mismatch between training and evaluation distributions, and what the next unit of data collection should buy us. This one drills down one more level — the real world is not a purely visual world; a lot of the state that decides success or failure lives on the contact interface. And general-purpose robots are exactly where the “contact → feedback → adjust-action” loop is least mature.
